data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $753.9m. During 2018 management reports net prior year reserve releases of $25.1m (2017: $39.7m), driven largely by favourable development and releases of prudential margins held above actuarial estimates; however movements were mixed by line (notably an adverse movement in Property). Several 2018 natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and California wildfires) impacted current year claims; reinsurance losses for certain events are quantified (e.g. California wildfires share ~$40m, aggregate storms ~$9m).
raw_causal_phrases: During 2018, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $25.1m (2017: $39.7m).
The syndicate has a consistent reserving philosophy, with initial reserves being set to include risk margins that may be released over time as and when any uncertainty reduces.
Historically these margins have given rise to held reserves within the range 5-10% above the actuarial estimates, which themselves include some margin for uncertainty.
The margin held above the actuarial estimate was 5% at the end of 2018 (2017: 5%).
Reserve releases in 2019 may be slightly lower than those over the last three years.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development GROSS movement was not explicitly reported in a single gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line. The report explicitly states net prior year reserve releases of $25.1m; no gross prior-year-only movement (insurance liabilities column) was found in the notes. Therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m value uses the publicly stated net prior-year reserve release ($25.1m) as a fallback. All monetary values are in the report's functional currency (USD). Field names retain the '_gbp_m' suffix per schema but amounts are native-currency millions (USD). Claims development triangle exists in Note 14 but a numeric extraction of the full gross development matrix was not performed here.
